components.name: Public service row
components.description: Public board with a dark masthead, overlapping white overall-health summary, and 12px container corners. The main outer cap is 1304px including 32px gutters, aligned with a 1240px masthead interior. Compact 83px service rows align name, checks-passed percentage, 30 daily bars, and current status; at 760px they reflow to identity/status, labeled percentage, then history with 20px main gutters. Percentages use recorded checks from the last 30 days, exclude gaps, and show three decimal places or an em dash without observations. Daily history distinguishes healthy, mixed, failed, and unobserved using the status-bar tokens. Hover, tap, or keyboard selects a date; Left/Right and Home/End navigate, Escape dismisses, and the associated tooltip reports date, percentage, and passed/total checks. The masthead shows Philippine-time last refresh, a 30-second countdown, Refreshing… when due, and Updates delayed after 45 seconds without fresh data. History accessibility: healthy fill #258653, mixed fill #a16d16, and missing-day outline #768395 provide at least 3:1 contrast against white. Tooltips allow continuous hover travel and Escape dismissal. A Daily details disclosure and native date selector provide 44px viewing targets and an announced percentage/count result on every viewport; rows expand naturally. The static specimen below illustrates an unobserved row; the live board provides daily interaction. Private dashboard and sign-in retain the Operations Register identity.

narrative.overview:
A quiet, compact workspace for checking service health during a working day. Cool gray ground, clean white rows, blue ink, aligned measurements, and restrained outline icons keep six private monitors easy to scan. Status color carries meaning; decoration is minimal.

The existing implementation is the authority for this document: `src/app/globals.css`, the dashboard, monitor-row and settings-panel components, and the desktop/mobile captures in `.impeccable/review/`. This is a record of the built interface. Component behaviors described beyond the overview screenshots were verified from source.
keyCharacteristics: Health and freshness appear before configuration detail.
Stable rows align names, observations, response times, and pass rates.
Pale surfaces, thin borders, and modest corners provide structure.
Unknown and absent observations remain explicit.

rules.name: The Observation Rule
rules.body: An empty bucket is not a passed check. Preserve separate passed, failed, and no-observation treatments, and retain accompanying text.

dos: **Do** keep status, observation age, and coverage visible alongside numeric results.
**Do** preserve the responsive row reflow and explicit mobile metric labels.
**Do** place monitor details and editing beneath the selected row.
**Do** pair color with labels, icons, legends, or accessible descriptions.
**Do** use the existing flat surfaces, compact type, and shared alignment for future screens.
donts: **Don't** fill missing history with successful checks or imply that local history was imported.
**Don't** treat an individual failed history bucket as interchangeable with a confirmed incident.
**Don't** turn unknown, paused, or unconfigured monitors into a healthy state.
**Don't** add decorative hero regions, imagery, or shadowed cards to this operations register.
